results.name: Original billboard: eight movies, 24 showtimes, header, banner and footer
Reusable Button: primary banner link, secondary favorite buttons and preserved navigation
Favorites: add two movies through onClick, visual variants and no duplicated IDs
Favorites: remove and re-add without changing other movies or reloading
localStorage: favorites and selected buttons survive an actual page reload
Controlled search inside banner: onChange updates input immediately, not the list
400 ms debounce: intermediate timers canceled, one console message and delayed result
MovieList: partial title, case-insensitive matching, surrounding spaces and favorite state
Empty state: unmatched title displays zero results and an accessible status message
Clearing search restores all original data, schedules and favorites
Removing all favorites persists an empty array after reload
Saved IDs are validated: duplicates and IDs outside the original billboard are discarded
Desktop and mobile layouts preserve the billboard without horizontal overflow
Browser console and local image requests have no errors
